title: 軌道扣件彈性設計
summary: 軌道扣件彈性設計以「扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。扣件同時控制鋼軌位置、提供彈性支承與維持電氣條件，增加夾持力並不保證所有性能改善；墊片、彈條與錨定件的路徑需分開辨認。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings locate the rail, provide resilient support and maintain electrical conditions; increasing clamping force does not improve every property, so pads, clips and anchors need separate load-path interpretation. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 墊片壓縮剛度與平行支承合成
stages.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness & Parallel support stiffness
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「墊片壓縮剛度」與「平行支承合成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pad compression stiffness" and "Parallel support stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墊片壓縮剛度」如何影響軌道扣件彈性設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pad compression stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Resilient rail-fastening design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剛度應由指定載重區間的力位移關係定義。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 44 kN/mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率。使用載入卸載斜率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墊片壓縮剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stiffness should be defined over a specified loading interval. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 44 kN/mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate. Use loading and unloading slopes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pad compression stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「墊片壓縮剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pad compression stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 墊片壓縮剛度
knowledge.text: 剛度應由指定載重區間的力位移關係定義。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 44 kN/mm。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffness should be defined over a specified loading interval. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「墊片壓縮剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pad compression stiffness" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴
剛度應由指定載重區間的力位移關係定義。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承不接觸時不能仍視為平行有效元件
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad.
Stiffness should be defined over a specified loading interval.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A support out of contact cannot remain an active parallel element.
quiz.explanation: 剛度應由指定載重區間的力位移關係定義。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stiffness should be defined over a specified loading interval. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊片壓縮剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pad compression stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 kN/mm。模型邊界：從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=44 kN/mm. Boundary: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以載入卸載斜率區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型分級力位移、預壓零點及卸載回復建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use loading and unloading slopes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 kN/mm。模型邊界：從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「墊片壓縮剛度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pad compression stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：偏斜安裝造成局部壓力集中
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：沿用垂向剛度會誤估軌距變化
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Skew installation concentrates local pressure.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using vertical stiffness misestimates gauge movement.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墊片壓縮剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pad compression stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以載入卸載斜率區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型分級力位移、預壓零點及卸載回復建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「墊片壓縮剛度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use loading and unloading slopes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load model stepwise force-displacement, preload origin and unloading recovery, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Pad compression stiffness. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「墊片壓縮剛度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴造成偏離的合成觀察，以載入卸載斜率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Pad compression stiffness, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. Explain which evidence in loading and unloading slopes distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以載入卸載斜率區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型分級力位移、預壓零點及卸載回復建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「墊片壓縮剛度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use loading and unloading slopes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load model stepwise force-displacement, preload origin and unloading recovery, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Pad compression stiffness. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.text: 重算「墊片壓縮剛度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴造成偏離的合成觀察，以載入卸載斜率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Pad compression stiffness, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. Explain which evidence in loading and unloading slopes distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「墊片壓縮剛度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pad compression stiffness"?
options: 本單元以載入卸載斜率區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型分級力位移、預壓零點及卸載回復建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：熱膨脹差可能改變預壓
optionsEn: Use loading and unloading slopes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Differential thermal expansion can change preload.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以載入卸載斜率區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型分級力位移、預壓零點及卸載回復建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use loading and unloading slopes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墊片壓縮剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pad compression stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴。這個失效與「墊片壓縮剛度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載入卸載斜率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. This failure and a measurement bias in Pad compression stiffness can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check loading and unloading slopes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用載入卸載斜率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴。這個失效與「墊片壓縮剛度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載入卸載斜率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad. This failure and a measurement bias in Pad compression stiffness can produce similar symptoms. quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel support stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把串聯當平行會高估支承剛度
支承不接觸時不能仍視為平行有效元件。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating series support as parallel overestimates stiffness.
A support out of contact cannot remain an active parallel element.
quiz.explanation: 支承不接觸時不能仍視為平行有效元件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A support out of contact cannot remain an active parallel element. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
